collection.title: BMW 3 Series Coupe 2006 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 2006 to 2008 version of a BMW 3 Series Coupe requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the wiper blade to the arm.
